sources.title: IndexedDB API
sources.note: Use IndexedDB for canonical structured personal records and binary objects; all writes occur inside transactions.

sources.title: Using IndexedDB
sources.note: Do not split a destructive clear-and-rewrite operation across transactions and do not rely on unload-time writes.

sources.title: Storage API
sources.note: Browser-managed storage is origin-scoped; best-effort storage may be evicted and persistent storage must be requested.

sources.title: Storage quotas and eviction criteria
sources.note: Quotas differ by browser and device; estimate values are approximate and the app must handle QuotaExceededError.

sources.title: StorageManager.estimate()
sources.note: Displayed usage and quota values are approximations and must be labelled as such.

sources.title: StorageManager.persist()
sources.note: A request can be accepted or rejected by the browser; rejection must not break the app.

sources.title: Broadcast Channel API
sources.note: Use same-origin messages to coordinate tabs; the protocol and conflict rules remain application responsibilities.

sources.title: The structured clone algorithm
sources.note: Backups must explicitly serialize values that JSON does not preserve, including Date, Map, Set, typed arrays and blobs.

sources.title: Compression Streams API
sources.note: Use feature detection; plain JSON remains the compatibility fallback.

sources.title: SubtleCrypto.digest()
sources.note: SHA-256 detects accidental corruption; it is not proof of authorship or secrecy.

sources.title: SubtleCrypto.encrypt() and AES-GCM parameters
sources.note: Encrypted backup is optional and requires secure-context feature detection, unique IVs and explicit password-loss warnings.

sources.title: SubtleCrypto.deriveKey()
sources.note: If encrypted export is implemented, parameters are versioned inside the envelope and never hidden in code defaults.

sources.title: RFC 4180: Common Format and MIME Type for CSV Files
sources.note: Use consistent comma-separated UTF-8 output, CRLF row endings and double-quote escaping.

sources.title: CSV Injection
sources.note: Human-view CSV exports require an explicit spreadsheet-safe mode for user-entered text; raw machine CSV remains separately labelled.

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
sources.note: Data-management, import, destructive reset and progress interfaces target WCAG 2.2 AA.
